title: Day 1: Historian Hysteria (part 1)
text:
Sample Advent of Code style task.

Given two lists of numbers, pair the smallest remaining number from each list and sum the absolute differences.

Example:
3   4
4   3
2   5
1   3
3   9
3   3

The answer for the example is 11.

Your puzzle input is available via aoc_get_input. Print only the numeric answer on stdout.
